newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Kia union to dishonour no dispute accord.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Kia union to dishonour no dispute accord.

text.p: The unions of key affiliates of troubled Kia Group have decided not to honour an agreement with management for the next three years which included a "no labour disputes" clause, a group spokesman said on Monday.
"The unions of Kia Motors and Asia Motors charged that the agreement was forced upon it by the creditors who want to make the group more attractive for a third-party sale," the spokesman said.
A statement from the Kia Motors union said the union would not give into the creditors' self-serving demands.
Leaders of the group's umbrella union earlier on Monday had agreed in principle to no disputes. The Kia group union has 28 affiliate unions.

The Kia and Asia unions said they were opposed to allowing management to reallocate workers according to the group's needs and had no plans to renew their collective bargaining proposals to accommodate the group's operations.
Kia Group was put under the protection of its creditor banks on July 15 after it was determined Kia would default on debt payments.
